name: Head & Neck Restraint Interface
description: Car-side interface for the driver frontal head restraint (FHR): helmet anchors, FHR-compatible belt geometry, and seat/cage head surround padding. Driver personal gear is noted only where it affects installation.

components.name: Frontal head restraint (HANS-type) device
components.description: Driver-worn FHR device tethered to the helmet; the shoulder belts hold the yoke down onto the driver. Drives harness choice (2 in FHR shoulder belts), belt angle (never upward; Schroth FHR manual) and harness-bar distance (≤ 8 in from seat back ideal).
components.location: Worn by driver, under shoulder belts (≈ x 1.95, y 0.93, z 0.37).

raceOptions.name: HANS / Simpson Hybrid / Schroth SHR / Stand 21 FHR (SFI 38.1, FIA 8858)
raceOptions.notes: Match device angle (20°/30°) to seat recline.

specs.Tether recert: Per device maker (often 5 years for tethers)

installNotes: Fit driver in seat with device before final harness-bar height.
Do not route shoulder belts straight down behind the seat without the harness bar (Schroth FHR).
inspection: Check tethers for wear, device for cracks.

sources.title: Schroth SHR Flex manual (shoulder belt mounting distance)

images.title: HANS Sport III head & neck restraint

modelRef.dimensions: HANS Sport III: M/L collar sizes, 20° layback, 0.80-0.85 kg; ~300 x 300 x 150 mm (estimated envelope)
modelRef.features: Carbon yoke on the shoulders with foam pads, rear collar behind the neck, tethers to the helmet posts

components.name: Helmet FHR anchor posts
components.description: Threaded anchor posts installed in the helmet shell (FIA 8858 / SFI-approved) that the FHR tethers clip onto. Most current SA/FIA helmets come pre-drilled; anchors are installed per helmet maker.

hardware.notes: Thread size/torque vary by helmet – follow helmet maker; do not drill helmets yourself.

installNotes: Have helmet maker or authorized dealer install anchors.
inspection: Check posts tight before each session.

images.title: HANS Sport III head & neck restraint

modelRef.dimensions: M6 helmet anchor posts on a ~270 x 280 x 250 mm SA2020 helmet
modelRef.features: Two FHR posts each side of the shell, tethers clip on

components.name: Head surround / head restraint padding
components.description: Energy-absorbing padding on the seat head surround (or a cage-mounted head restraint if the seat lacks one) that limits lateral and rearward head motion. Many sanctioning bodies require a head restraint immediately behind/beside the helmet.

raceOptions.name: Seat-maker head surround pads / FIA 8857 Type A foam

specs.Material: SFI 45.1 or FIA 8857-2001 Type A foam

installNotes: Set gap to helmet ≈ 1 in with driver seated.

sources.title: FIA Appendix J Art. 253-8 (2020) Safety Cages
SCCA Time Trials – Full Safety Rules

modelRef.dimensions: ~45 mm thick pads inside the seat head wings (~310 mm between wings)
modelRef.features: Rear and side head pads in the seat head surround
